uploadAccepted: Accepted. Chunking and embedding in background; refresh later to check status
instantHit: Instant upload: an identical file already exists, nothing was transferred
resumeDetected: Previous upload progress found ({done}/{total} chunks already done)
retryConfirm: Retry "{name}"? Embedding resumes from the last checkpoint, not from scratch.
deleteConfirm: Delete document "{name}"? All of its vector chunks will be removed.
queryPlaceholder: Type a question to verify hybrid retrieval quality
searchEmpty: No chunks matched. Upload documents first or rephrase the question
